name: @oktopeak/lawmatics-mcp

tools.name: list-matters
tools.description: List matters (leads/prospects/clients) with optional filter, sort, and pagination. Matter status is 'pnc' (potential new client), 'hired', or 'lost'. Useful filters: status, practice_area_id, stage_id, source_id, sub_status_id, created_at, estimated_value_cents, actual_value_cents. For pipeline reporting, combine filter_by with fields and fetch_all, then aggregate the result.

page.description: Page number (Lawmatics returns a fixed 25 records per page).

sort_by.description: Attribute to sort by, e.g. 'created_at', 'updated_at', 'id'. Default: id, newest first.

filter_by.description: Attribute to filter on. IMPORTANT: the Lawmatics API supports only ONE filter per request. Association filters use the _id suffix, e.g. practice_area_id, stage_id, source_id, matter_id, contact_id.

filter_on.description: Value to filter for. Required with filter_by unless filter_with is null/not_null.

filter_with.description: Filter operator: =, !=, <, <=, >, >=, like, ilike (default: ilike for text — add % wildcards for fuzzy match, e.g. %smith%), or presence checks: null, not_null. Currency values are in cents.

fields.description: Comma-separated attributes to return, or 'all' for everything. Add 'custom_fields' to include custom field values.

fetch_all.description: Follow pagination and return every record (capped at 1,000). The response says complete=false if truncated.

tools.name: get-matter
tools.description: Get full details for a single matter by ID, including custom fields and related records (contact, stage, practice area, tasks, notes, events, invoices as {id, type} references).

tools.name: find-matter
tools.description: Find a single matter by exact email, phone, or name. Returns the best match or not_found. For fuzzy or multi-result searches use list-matters with filter_with: 'ilike' and % wildcards.

value.description: The email address, phone number, or full name to look up.

tools.name: create-matter
tools.description: Create a new matter (lead). By default this also creates a contact from first/last name. Pass contact_id to attach an existing contact, or match_contact_by to reuse a contact matched on email/name/phone (falls back to creating one). Pass company_id or company_name for a company matter. Tags that don't exist yet are created automatically.

contact_id.description: Attach an existing contact. Overrides match_contact_by.

match_contact_by.description: Reuse an existing contact matched on this attribute instead of creating a duplicate.

company_id.description: Create as a company matter for this company.

company_name.description: Create as a company matter, matching the company by name.

notes.description: Notes to create with the matter.

tags.description: Tag names to attach (auto-created if missing).

tools.name: update-matter
tools.description: Update a matter. Only the provided fields change. Note: the public API has no documented way to move a matter between pipeline stages — sub_status_id is the closest control.

tools.name: get-form
tools.description: Get one custom form including its field layout (field IDs, labels, types, required flags).

tools.name: get-form-entries
tools.description: List submissions for a custom form, each with label/value pairs and the matter it created.

tools.name: submit-form
tools.description: Submit an entry to a custom form — creates a matter/contact and fires the form's automations, exactly like a website submission. Standard keys: first_name, last_name, email, phone. Custom fields use the key form 'custom_field_<id>' (IDs from get-form or list-custom-fields). utm_source/utm_campaign/utm_medium/utm_term are also accepted.

data.description: Field values keyed by field ID, e.g. {"first_name": "Jane", "custom_field_2263": "yes"}.
